data.normalization: one scalar training mean and standard deviation

numerics.loss: 0.5 * trapezoidal L2 reconstruction squared + latent_penalty * Euclidean latent norm squared
numerics.query_sampling: numpy PCG64; with replacement; trapezoidal node probabilities
numerics.learning_rate_schedule: cosine; first update at learning_rate; final update at minimum_learning_rate
numerics.initialization: shared initial parameter archive generated by the native Flax model
